notes.title: Haustoria Release
notes.content:
Haustoria Dev here. First of all, big thank you to all who have supported me these past 2 years in the development of this project. It's been quite the journey! I couldn't have done it without your support. 

Haustoria is now release and available for download. I really hope you enjoy it! 

Patch: There was one typo a player let me know of. That has been fixed :)
